name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2025-11-29, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
